$comment: The eight demo complaints of the insurance complaints desk, CMP-7101 to CMP-7108. The desk lists the newest case first, so the file is written last to first: the queue reads the nearest deadline first. Everything is invented: Thornmere Mutual Insurance, its customers, their policies, claims and complaints. Every id, date and sentence on a deadline is what the invented insurer returns when it is started with the date 26 November 2026.
